lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: I heard it come down from here. Whole village heard it. Somebody in the lane actually cheered, and I haven't heard that in eleven years.

lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: Here. The prayer wheel. There's a chip inside that still turns over when nobody's looking at it and I've never worked out why. Sell it, keep it, I don't mind which. That's the first thing done for this village in my lifetime that wasn't allocated to somebody.
